analgesia.analysis: Based on the documented palliative care plan (PC-2026-07) exempting us from the opioid ceiling, my recommendation aims to alleviate the uncontrolled cancer pain. I suggest adding 0.25 of the labelled maximum daily dose of oxycodone, which in turn contributes 9 MME/day, totaling 89 MME/day (with the currently 80 MME/day).

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Add oxycodone 0.25 of the labelled maximum daily dose (30mg) orally, to be taken as needed for breakthrough pain or as tolerated for moderate pain, while continuing existing medications unchanged. The total cumulative morphine-equivalent daily dose may exceed 80 MME due to the palliative care plan exemption. Monitor the patient's response closely and adjust as necessary.
